name: Financial Support to the Students of NER for Higher Professional Courses (NEC Merit Scholarship)
provider: North Eastern Council (NEC), Ministry of Development of North Eastern Region

rules.quote: the scholarship shall be admissible to the students whose parent / guardian’s annual income from all sources shall not exceed Rs 8.0 lakh.
Students fulfilling the eligibility criteria of the scheme guidelines of NEC Merit Scholarship of Ministry of DoNER are eligible to apply for these scholarships.

rules.value: purely merit on qualifying exam marks; no category/religion/gender quota
rules.quote: There will not be any reservation/quota on the basis of category/religion/gender.

rules.value: fresh only in year of commencement; renewal every year
rules.quote: a student shall only be considered for scholarship in the year of commencement of his/her course. For subsequent year of course, only renewal will be allowed.

rules.value: MPhil/PhD selection on NER-relevant research topic
rules.quote: Selection of students for M. Phil and Ph. D. will be done on the basis of topic of research/Synopsis which has relevance to the problems/issues related to NE Region.

amount.text: Per annum: Diploma Rs 20,000; Degree Rs 22,000; PG Rs 25,000; MPhil/PhD Rs 30,000
amount.quote: Diploma 20,000/-p.a. Degree 22,000/- p.a. Post graduate 25,000/- p.a. M. Phil./Ph D 30,000/- p.a.

deadline.text: NSP 2026-27 lists this scheme for renewal only; student application close 31-10-2026 (registers/nsp_central_2026_27.csv)
